isolation.status: Previous batch incident file retained at the same observed hash. This batch did not restore, delete or rewrite it. All new Node tests assert fixture user data before importing settings; cost/lifecycle/native wrapper check project fallback hash.

limits: Complete initial/recovery/legacy snapshots and network/download/other unconverted IPC responses remain.
Media preparation and update callbacks still clone full settings twice; tag preparation/normalization/worker encoding are not eliminated.
Large business results (bulk tags, one huge entity) can still be large. Response JSON bytes are not actual IPC wire byte counts.
A successful durable mutation may be followed by a visible synchronization failure; the client does not roll back or automatically resend it.
Synchronous compatibility rebases retain existing follow-up-write semantics; no additional cross-file or power-loss transaction guarantee.

R6 physical-device decode/contention/rotation/PSS, R7 remaining full reads/logical repositories/feature-type splits/cold stability, and R8 dependency/migration/recovery/signing/update/TLS remain open.
